tools.name: finalize_asset
tools.description: Finalize an authored collection, or a batch of requests, through every step and import it into Unreal. Pass exactly one of collection (with export_root) or requests, a list of finalize requests that run one at a time in order under one job lock; the top-level options fill in any key a request omits. fail_fast skips the rest of a batch after a failure, otherwise the rest still run. wait_for_lock waits for another finalize job to release the lock, for at most lock_wait_seconds, instead of failing with finalize.job_running. pie_mode wait (default) or refuse: an import waits up to pie_wait_seconds for Play In Editor to end, or fails with import_ue.editor_busy. Unreal import timeouts are retried with back-off (NMG_GAME_DEV_UE_RETRIES default 4, NMG_GAME_DEV_UE_RETRY_DELAY_S default 20). Returns {job_id, status} at once; includes the result when the job finishes within wait_seconds (0-150), and for a batch result.batch lists each collection's state with succeeded, failed, and skipped counts.

requests.description: A batch: finalize request objects with the collection keys (collection, category, asset_class, export_root, blend, budgets_path, device, pie_mode, pie_wait_seconds). Exclusive with collection.

tools.name: run_finalize_step
tools.description: Run one finalize step (validate, bake, variants, export, reimport, or import_ue) through the same implementation finalize_asset uses. Returns {job_id, status} at once, or the finished result within wait_seconds (0-150). wait_for_lock and lock_wait_seconds bound the wait for another job's lock, and the pie options behave as in finalize_asset: import_ue fails with import_ue.editor_busy when Play In Editor stays on. Unreal import timeouts are retried with back-off (NMG_GAME_DEV_UE_RETRIES default 4, NMG_GAME_DEV_UE_RETRY_DELAY_S default 20).

tools.name: get_finalize_job
tools.description: Return a finalize job's state, step, progress, message, batch progress (total, completed, current collection and index, and each item's state), and result or error. An unknown id returns finalize.job_not_found.
